title: Rate Manual Credits: Vault and Safe Percentages on the Valuables Floater
content:
Larkspur Valuables Floater rate manual, storage credits. Two credits may reduce the premium for scheduled jewelry and watches: a vault credit for items kept in a bank vault, and a safe credit for a residence with a central-station alarm and a home safe. The percentages are set by tier.

| Tier | Vault credit (percent of jewelry and watch premium) | Safe credit (percent of jewelry and watch premium) |
|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | 0 | 0 |
| Valuables Floater Select | 0 | 5 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | 40 | 5 |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | 40 | 10 |
| Valuables Floater Collector | 50 | 10 |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | 50 | 15 |

## Notes

- Both credits are percentages of the premium for the jewelry and watches classes only; no other class premium is reduced by them.
- The Valuables Floater Classic shows 0 for both credits; the Valuables Floater Select shows 0 for the vault credit.

## Hypothetical credit figures

A hypothetical jewelry and watch premium of 300.00 USD before any storage credit:

| Tier | Vault credit | Safe credit |
|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Select | 0.00 USD | 15.00 USD (5 percent) |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | 120.00 USD (40 percent) | 30.00 USD (10 percent) |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | 150.00 USD (50 percent) | 45.00 USD (15 percent) |
